**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (insert proposed at preferred level).**

What I checked:
- Full-text searches for "insur", "coverage", "certificate", "policy": the only hit is the recital reference to third-party "mortgage insurers" (p0005) — no insurance covenant exists.
- Every candidate and unlisted article: Section 3 Hosting Services (p0030–p0042), Section 8 Client covenants, Section 9 TrueLink warranties, Section 10 Confidentiality, Section 11 Standard of Care, Section 12 Indemnity, and miscellaneous Sections 13–30 — all silent on insurance. Exhibits A and B are placeholders.
- Direction: the obligation runs against TrueLink (Vendor), so it benefits us; no risk of flagging our own obligation.

Why it fails fallback: TrueLink hosts our Web Site and data files (p0031, p0038) and transmits/archives borrower Credit Data (p0015, p0042) — a vendor processing personal data with zero insurance, which is walk-away territory and fails both fallback elements (E&O USD 1M, cyber USD 2M). Its own indemnity (p0073/p0075) is unbacked and its liability for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 is capped at 12 months' fees (p0077), so insurance is the practical recovery source.

The fix: a single insert of Section 12(c) inside the indemnity article — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M covering Credit Data processing, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request — with the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) flagged in the comment as our negotiating room. Redline validated ok:true with the minimality gate clean.
